problems.표본:
def sample(rng):
    """비교기 9개. 각각 (i, j), i < j."""
    out = []

        i = rng.randrange(5 - 1)
        j = rng.randrange(i + 1, 5)
        out.append([i, j])
    return out

problems.표본:
def sample(rng):
    import random
    net = []
    for _ in range(9):
        i = rng.randrange(4)
        j = rng.randrange(i + 1, 5)
        net.append([i, j])
    witness = []
    for bits in range(32):
        v = [(bits >> t) & 1 for t in range(5)]
        steps = [list(v)]
        for i, j in net:
            if v[i] > v[j]:
                v[i], v[j] = v[j], v[i]
            steps.append(list(v))
        witness.append(steps)
    return [net, witness]
